title: 考虑地缘政治等影响，进行下周美股市场分析

key_drivers: Market breadth is at historical extremes — mega-cap tech concentration masks underlying index fragility; a breadth-driven correction risk is elevated
The Fed is likely holding rates steady through summer, with markets pricing out rate cuts until at least Q3 2026, keeping equity multiples under structural pressure
Geopolitical risk premia are elevated entering late June 2026, with US-China tech friction, Russia-Ukraine stalemate, and Middle East instability as the top three vectors
Next week's key catalyst is the PCE inflation report (month-end): an upside surprise could trigger a correlated selloff by fusing rate fears with geopolitical anxiety
Defense, energy, and AI infrastructure sectors offer relative resilience; consumer discretionary and financials face asymmetric downside in elevated geopolitical risk
synthesis_history.reversal_condition: 以下任一条件满足可重新评估升级为 buy：(1) 月末 PCE 通胀数据低于或符合预期且 VIX 回落至 25 以下；(2) 中美科技贸易摩擦、俄乌或中东任一向量出现实质性缓和信号；(3) 市场广度改善（突破日 advance/decline 比例回归正常区间）。若 VIX 确认突破 25 或 PCE 超预期上行，则应进一步下调至 reduce
